title: Feedback (a correction)
description: One correction of a learner's text: an item of kv exams.feedbackLocal (a one-click Schreiben correction made here, or one carried over from the B1 exam app), sent as data/feedback-ai/*.json by its feedback.created event. author, model and promptVersion say who or what wrote it and with which prompt (additive: records from before they existed have none of them).

author.description: ai: written by a model (Claude) from this app; tutor: a person or a tutor agent reviewing the learner's work; self: the learner

model.description: the model that wrote it, as the API reported it (author ai)

promptVersion.description: the versioned prompt it was written with, e.g. schreiben-exam@1 (services/claude.js PROMPTS)
